THE HAIR BRIEF

A CLEARER PLACE TO START

WHAT DOES YOUR HAIR NEED?

Start with the goal, then add history, upkeep, time, budget, and uncertainty. The brief suggests a conversation or starting service. It does not assess hair health or promise a result.

START WITH THE GOAL

COLOR OR DIMENSION
SHAPE OR MOVEMENT
LENGTH OR VOLUME
FIX OR RETHINK SOMETHING

Start with a real goal. Leave room for the truth.

GOAL FIRST. FORMULA SECOND.

WHY CLIENTS CHOOSE RACHEL

THE DIFFERENCE IS THE CONVERSATION.

Technique matters. So does the part where someone listens, explains the tradeoffs, and gives you a plan that works beyond the mirror.

THE FORMULA

CUSTOMIZED TO YOU, NOT COPIED FROM A PHOTO

Two people can show Rachel the same reference and mean completely different things. Every formula responds to your skin tone, eye color, haircut, styling habits, and real life.

THE BOUNDARY

HEALTHY HAIR ALWAYS WINS

Healthy hair looks more expensive than over-processed hair. Rachel would rather take a slower, healthier path than push too hard in one appointment.

THE HANDOFF

YOU LEAVE KNOWING WHAT HAPPENED AND WHAT COMES NEXT

Rachel explains the choices, the technique, and the home care. Understanding your own hair is part of keeping the result beautiful after you leave the chair.

THE SERVICE EDIT

LESS MENU. MORE CLARITY.

Find your starting point, compare the options, and choose a time with Rachel. New to color or extensions? Start with a free consultation.
